claims.claim: DBS, OCBC and UOB jointly completed first live SGD tokenised-deposit interbank transactions on Swift's ledger
claims.reason: S1 says DBS, OCBC and UOB completed live domestic SGD transactions using tokenised deposits on Swift's blockchain-based ledger. It calls this the first time the three banks have executed live interbank transactions using tokenised deposits.

claims.claim: The transactions were completed on 10 Sep
claims.reason: S1 is a press release dated 10 September 2026. It says the banks 'have successfully completed' the transactions but does not give the date they were carried out. 10 Sep is the announcement date, not a stated transaction date.

claims.claim: No unilateral move by a member that peers must follow was found
claims.reason: None of the cited sources describes a single bank making a move that peers are likely to follow. S1 covers a joint action. S2 covers the Fed rate hike's effect on all three banks. S3 is a Jefferies coverage initiation. Nothing contradicts the absence claim.
